Luxury 3-Bedroom Apartment for Rent at 1 JBR, JBR, Dubai

Step into unparalleled luxury with this stunning 3-bedroom apartment at 1 JBR, located in the iconic Jumeirah Beach Residences (JBR). With breathtaking views of the Sea, Palm Jumeirah, this spacious apartment seamlessly blends modern design with world-class amenities, offering a lifestyle of ultimate comfort and elegance.

Property Details:

3 Master Bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms
Spacious Maid Room (or Study Room)
2 Large Balconies with stunning views
2 Generously Sized Storage Rooms
Fully Equipped Open Kitchen
Floor-to-ceiling windows for ample natural light
Built-in Wardrobes
Guest Water Closet
Sea Views / Palm Jumeirah Views / Dubai Eye Views
Private Lobby & Private Elevator
High Floor for panoramic vistas

Additional Features:

Chiller Empower (Cooling)
Gas Electrical
2 Free Parking Spaces
10% Deposit Required
2,130 AED for DEWA (for first-time residents in Dubai)
EJARI

Community and Location:

Direct access to JBR’s private beach
24/7 security and concierge services
World-class gym and pool facilities
Close to high-end dining and shopping at The Walk
Prime location with easy access to Dubai Marina, Palm Jumeirah, and key city attractions.
